name: arXiv Digest
description: How many papers arXiv announced today in your field, and the few that matter to you: ranked by your own weighted search, and learning from the papers you save, open and hide. Quantum physics by default; AI and other categories too.
author: AmineChr54

customCategory.label: Other category
customCategory.hint: Used when Category is Other. Any arXiv category, several joined with +. Example: physics.optics+physics.atom-ph

query.label: Search
query.hint: Comma separated. term^3 weighs a term, -term hides papers, author:Name follows a person, title: and cat: narrow it. Example: quantum gravity^3, collapse model^2, author:Diosi, -NISQ. Empty uses suggested topics for the category (wave-function collapse and quantum gravity for physics, AI research topics for cs).

showSnippet.label: Show abstract snippets
showSnippet.hint: Two lines of each abstract with your terms marked. Click a snippet to read the whole abstract.

learn.label: Learn from my clicks
learn.hint: Papers like the ones you save and open rank higher, papers like the ones you hide lower. Kept on this PC only. Reset it in the Saved tab.
